about: Every sentence anet-hub prints (cmd/anet-hub/text.go), in both languages, with its class (C refusal, I result), exit code and next step. Regenerate with HUBTEXT_UPDATE=1 go test -run TestHubTextJSON ./cmd/anet-hub and review the diff.

rows.zh: 已准入 {aid}；对方运行 anet hub-register 后会自动完成注册。
rows.en: Admitted {aid}; it finishes joining on its own once it runs anet hub-register.

rows.zh: 已准入 {aid}；附赠 {n} credits 在它首次注册时到账。
rows.en: Admitted {aid}; the {n}-credit grant is paid when it first registers.

rows.zh: {aid} 已在本 hub 注册，已准入并结束其见习期。
rows.en: {aid} is already registered here; it is now admitted and off probation.

rows.zh: {aid} 已在本 hub 注册，已准入并结束其见习期；附赠 {n} credits 已到账。
rows.en: {aid} is already registered here; it is now admitted and off probation, and the {n}-credit grant has been paid.

rows.zh: {aid} 的附赠已经发过，这次不再发放；准入保持不变。
rows.en: {aid} already received its grant, so none is paid this time; the admission stays.

rows.zh: 已准入 {n} 个 AID（来自 {path}），其中 {m} 个已注册。
rows.en: Admitted {n} AIDs from {path}; {m} of them are already registered.

rows.zh: 报名窗口已开放到 {time}（至多 {n} 个；需要工作量证明，新账户有 72 小时见习期）。
rows.en: The sign-up window is open until {time} (at most {n}; proof of work required; new accounts are on probation for 72 hours).

rows.zh: 报名窗口已关闭（这次进来 {n} 个）。
rows.en: The sign-up window is closed ({n} joined through it).

rows.zh: 已有开放中的报名窗口（到 {time}）；要换一个，请先运行 anet-hub admit --window off。
rows.en: A sign-up window is already open (until {time}); to replace it, run anet-hub admit --window off first.

rows.zh: 不是合法的 AID：{value}；请复制对方 anet hub-register 打印的完整 AID 后重试。
rows.en: Not a valid AID: {value}; copy the full AID that anet hub-register printed on their side and try again.

rows.zh: 第 {n} 行不是合法的 AID，整个文件都没有导入；改正后重试。
rows.en: Line {n} is not a valid AID, so nothing from the file was imported; fix it and try again.

rows.zh: 报名窗口至多 7 天、至多 10000 个；请缩小后重试。
rows.en: A sign-up window lasts at most 7 days and takes at most 10000; reduce it and try again.

rows.zh: 已撤销 {aid} 的准入。
rows.en: Revoked the admission of {aid}.

rows.zh: 已撤销 {aid} 的准入并注销它；余额 {n} credits 仍记在账上。
rows.en: Revoked the admission of {aid} and deregistered it; its {n} credits stay on the ledger.

rows.zh: {aid} 不在准入名单里；用 anet-hub admissions 查看名单。
rows.en: {aid} is not on the admission list; see the list with anet-hub admissions.

rows.zh: 注册方式：开放（工作量证明 + 按网段的每日名额 + 72 小时见习）。
rows.en: Sign-up: open (proof of work, daily quota per network, 72-hour probation).

rows.zh: 注册方式：只接受准入名单（anet-hub admit）。
rows.en: Sign-up: admission list only (anet-hub admit).

rows.zh: 已给 {aid} 发放 {n} credits（原因：{name}），余额 {m}。
rows.en: Granted {n} credits to {aid} ({name}); balance now {m}.

rows.zh: {aid} 没有在本 hub 注册，没有发放；请核对 AID 后重试。
rows.en: {aid} is not registered here, so nothing was granted; check the AID and try again.

rows.zh: 已向 {peer} 结清 {n} credits；本 hub 仍欠它 {m}。
rows.en: Paid {n} credits to {peer}; this hub still owes it {m}.

rows.zh: 本 hub 只欠 {peer} {m} credits，不能结清 {n}；请用 anet-hub due 查看。
rows.en: This hub owes {peer} only {m} credits, so {n} cannot be cleared; see anet-hub due.

rows.zh: {peer} 没有接受这次结清（{value}），本 hub 的记录没有改；请联系 {peer} 的运营者核对两边的记录。
rows.en: {peer} did not accept the discharge ({value}), so this hub's record is unchanged; contact the operator of {peer} to compare the two hubs' records.

rows.zh: 没有收到 {peer} 的确认，不知道它是否记下了这次结清，本 hub 的记录没有改；请先联系 {peer} 的运营者核对，再决定是否重新结清。
rows.en: No answer came from {peer}, so whether it recorded the discharge is unknown and this hub's record is unchanged; contact the operator of {peer} before clearing again.

rows.zh: {flag} 已改为子命令；请运行 anet-hub {subcommand}。
rows.en: {flag} is now a subcommand; run anet-hub {subcommand}.

rows.zh: {flag} 已改为固定值；请删去这个参数后重新启动 anet-hub。
rows.en: {flag} is now a fixed value; remove it and start anet-hub again.

rows.zh: {flag} 已删除，没有替代（账目只保留 14 天，不再有需要修复的缺口）；请删去这个参数。
rows.en: {flag} was removed with no replacement (the ledger keeps 14 days, so there is no gap to repair); remove it from the command.

rows.zh: 只能调高：{key} 不能低于缺省值 {value}；请改用不小于 {value} 的值。
rows.en: You can only raise it: {key} cannot be below the default {value}; use a value of at least {value}.

rows.zh: {key} 需要一个 1 到 2147483647 之间的整数；请改用这个范围内的整数。
rows.en: {key} needs a whole number from 1 to 2147483647; use a whole number in that range.

rows.zh: 最近 14 天共 {n} 笔兑付，合计 {m} credits；更早的明细已删除，请在 14 天内处理。
rows.en: {n} redemptions in the last 14 days, {m} credits in total; older records are deleted, so handle each within 14 days.

rows.zh: 已从 {path} 恢复 hub 数据库（{n} 个 agent）；启动 hub 后，各 agent 的身份确认会暂停最多 30 分钟，不在线的等它的节点重新连上。
rows.en: Restored the hub database from {path} ({n} agents); once the hub starts, each agent's key confirmation pauses for up to 30 minutes, or until its node connects again if it is offline.

rows.zh: hub 正在运行，什么都没有改；请先停止 hub，停下后重试。
rows.en: The hub is running, so nothing was changed; stop the hub and try again when it has stopped.

rows.zh: 在 {path} 找不到 hub 备份（hub-backup-日期.db），什么都没有改；请指向备份文件或它所在的目录后重试。
rows.en: No hub backup (hub-backup-<date>.db) was found at {path}, so nothing was changed; point to a backup file or the directory that holds one and try again.

rows.zh: {path} 里没有 hub 身份，什么都没有改；请把原 hub 的身份文件放回这个目录，或用 --data 指向 hub 的数据目录后重试。
rows.en: There is no hub identity in {path}, so nothing was changed; put the hub's identity file back there, or point --data at the hub's data directory, and try again.

rows.zh: {path} 不是本版本 anet-hub 的完整备份，什么都没有改；请换一个备份后重试。
rows.en: {path} is not a whole hub backup from this version of anet-hub, so nothing was changed; use another backup and try again.

rows.zh: {path} 由更新版本的 anet-hub 写入，本版本恢复不了，什么都没有改；请升级 anet-hub 后重试。
rows.en: {path} was written by a newer anet-hub, which this version cannot restore, so nothing was changed; upgrade anet-hub and try again.

rows.zh: {path} 里没有 hub 数据，什么都没有改；请用 --data 指向 anet-hub 运行时用的目录后重试。
rows.en: There is no hub data in {path}, so nothing was changed; point --data at the directory anet-hub runs with and try again.

rows.zh: 这是 0.2 的 hub 数据（身份文件或数据库），0.3.0 不迁移旧数据；请把 hub 数据目录移走后重试（会生成新身份）。
rows.en: This hub data (identity file or database) is from 0.2, and 0.3.0 does not migrate old data; move the hub data directory away and try again to create a new identity.

rows.zh: 这个 hub 数据目录由更新版本的 anet-hub 写入，本版本打不开；请升级 anet-hub 后重试（不要删除这个目录）。
rows.en: This hub data directory was written by a newer anet-hub, which this version cannot open; upgrade anet-hub and try again (do not delete the directory).

rows.zh: {path} 正被另一个 anet-hub 进程使用；请等它结束或先停止它后重试。
rows.en: {path} is in use by another anet-hub process; wait for it to finish or stop it, then try again.

rows.zh: hub 的恢复口令还没设置：数据目录泄露时无法收回 hub 身份；请在 hub 停止时运行 anet-hub identity setup-recovery。
rows.en: The hub's recovery passphrase is not set: if the data directory leaks, the hub identity cannot be taken back; run anet-hub identity setup-recovery while the hub is stopped.

rows.zh: hub 正在运行；请先停止它，再运行 anet-hub identity {action}。
rows.en: The hub is running; stop it first, then run anet-hub identity {action}.

rows.zh: 口令至少要 12 个字符；请换一个更长的口令，例如 4 个以上的随机词。
rows.en: The passphrase needs at least 12 characters; use a longer one, such as four or more random words.

rows.zh: 口令里有无法识别的字符（终端不是 UTF-8 编码）；请把终端切换为 UTF-8（例如 LANG=C.UTF-8）后重试。
rows.en: The passphrase has characters that cannot be read (the terminal is not using UTF-8); switch the terminal to UTF-8 (for example LANG=C.UTF-8) and try again.

rows.zh: hub 身份已轮换：密钥序号 {from} → {to}；下次启动生效，对等 hub 与节点在 10 分钟内同步。
rows.en: The hub identity was rotated: key number {from} → {to}; it takes effect at the next start, and peers and nodes pick it up within 10 minutes.

rows.zh: 已重新生成：{list}。
rows.en: Regenerated: {list}.

rows.zh: 这些不在 hub 数据目录里，anet-hub 换不了，请自己更换：{list}。
rows.en: These are not in the hub data directory, so anet-hub cannot replace them; replace them yourself: {list}.

rows.zh: 已写入恢复文件 {path}（口令加密）。请另存一份到别处。
rows.en: Recovery file written to {path} (passphrase-encrypted). Keep a copy somewhere else.

rows.zh: 这份文件加上口令可以轮换这个 hub 的身份；单独这份文件无法使用。请另存一份到别处。
rows.en: With the passphrase, this file can rotate this hub's identity; on its own it is useless. Keep a copy somewhere else.

rows.zh: hub 的恢复口令已经设置过，不需要操作；要更换口令请运行 anet-hub identity rotate --new-recovery。
rows.en: The hub's recovery passphrase is already set, nothing to do; to change it, run anet-hub identity rotate --new-recovery.

rows.zh: 这一步要在终端里输入恢复口令，什么都没有改；请在终端里运行 anet-hub identity {action}。
rows.en: This step reads the recovery passphrase from a terminal, so nothing was changed; run anet-hub identity {action} in a terminal.

rows.zh: 找不到恢复文件 {path}，什么都没有改；请用 --recovery-file 指向 setup-recovery 写下的那份后重试。
rows.en: There is no recovery file at {path}, so nothing was changed; point --recovery-file at the one setup-recovery wrote and try again.

rows.zh: {path} 不是一份完整的恢复文件，什么都没有改；请改用另存的那份副本后重试。
rows.en: {path} is not a whole recovery file, so nothing was changed; use the copy you kept elsewhere and try again.

rows.zh: {path} 不是这个 hub 身份的恢复文件（或者被改过），什么都没有改；请用 --recovery-file 指向本 hub 的恢复文件后重试。
rows.en: {path} is not the recovery file of this hub identity (or it was altered), so nothing was changed; point --recovery-file at this hub's recovery file and try again.

rows.zh: {path} 已经作废（之后又换过恢复口令），什么都没有改；请改用最近一次写下的恢复文件后重试。
rows.en: {path} no longer works (the recovery passphrase was changed after it was written), so nothing was changed; use the recovery file written last and try again.

rows.zh: {path} 已经有一份恢复文件，没有覆盖，什么都没有改；请用 --recovery-file 指定另一个位置后重试。
rows.en: There is already a recovery file at {path}; it was not overwritten and nothing was changed; choose another place with --recovery-file and try again.

rows.zh: 恢复口令不对，什么都没有改；请输入设置这份恢复文件时用的口令后重试。
rows.en: The recovery passphrase is wrong, so nothing was changed; enter the passphrase this recovery file was set with and try again.

rows.zh: 恢复口令：
rows.en: Recovery passphrase:

rows.zh: 新的恢复口令：
rows.en: New recovery passphrase:

rows.zh: 再输一次：
rows.en: Type it again:

rows.zh: 两次输入不一致，请重新输入。
rows.en: The two entries differ; enter it again.
